SELECT
FROM sys_user WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id AND rm.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted_at = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted_at = 0 AND m.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND m.permission_code <> '' UNION SELECT DISTINCT m.permission_code FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted_at = 0 AND m.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND m.permission_code <> '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_super_admin = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 )

WITH RECURSIVE assigned_menu AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id AND rm.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted_at = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 UNION SELECT m.id FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted_at = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_super_admin = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 ) ), authorized_tree AS ( SELECT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN assigned_menu assigned ON assigned.id = m.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted_at = 0 UNION DISTINCT SELECT parent.* FROM sys_menu parent INNER JOIN authorized_tree child ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.status = 1 AND parent.deleted_at = 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT menu_code FROM authorized_tree ORDER BY menu_code
SELECT dept_name FROM sys_department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0

SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY r.id
SELECT ip_cidr FROM sys_ip_rule WHERE status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 AND ( scope_type = 1 OR (scope_type = 2 AND user_id = #{userId}) )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at = #{loginAt}, last_login_ip = #{loginIp}, login_failed_count = 0 WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted_at = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET login_failed_count = login_failed_count + 1 WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted_at = 0

UPDATE sys_user SET mfa_status = 1, mfa_secret_ciphertext = #{secretCiphertext}, mfa_bound_at = #{boundAt}, mfa_last_used_counter = #{counter} WHERE id = #{userId} AND mfa_status = 0 AND deleted_at = 0
